racingTvHorseData.name: Tuscan Point
racingTvHorseData.analystComment: Finally opened his account on stable debut at Southwell (6f) in March. Similar form on 2 of his 3 starts since, second of 8 in handicap at Catterick (5f, good to firm) 8 days ago. Eyeshields nw refitted and big shout from same mark.

prompts.finish: Tuscan Point has finished 1st for Finishing Speed Percentage in 3 of their last 4 completions.
prompts.speed: Tuscan Point has finished 1st for Top Speed in 3 of their last 6 starts.
prompts.time: Tuscan Point has finished faster than the Par Time in 3 of their last 4 races.

performances.commentFull: in a change of headgear, bounced back to form having his first outing on turf since joining current yard, going down only narrowly; in touch, led 1f out, edged out final strides; he has an ungainly way of going about things but seems to give his all.
found run of good form since joining this yard coming to a halt; in touch, raced freely, ridden under 2f out, no extra last ½f.

the first runner for Adam Kirby as he joins the training ranks and the ex-jockey could hardly have made a better start as Tuscan Point bolted up having left Richard Fahey, first-time eyeshields/tongue strap both plausible catalysts as he made his return from 5 months off; mid-field, travelled well, headway over 2f out, led approaching final 1f, drew clear, won easily; he was 0-15 coming into this but had tumbled down the weights for previous yard and took full advantage, trying to find a race under a penalty in the near future seemingly prudent given the handicapper is sure to react.
back on turf, was still below form given how far he was behind the first 2 and remains a maiden; held up, pushed along over 2f out, merely plugged on.
back in headgear, was unsuited by the way the race developed having his first start on the all-weather; held up, not settle fully, ridden over 2f out, soon beaten.

matched his recent Musselburgh effort under these different conditions but continues to give the impression he's going to be hard to win with; soon steadied, not settle fully, progress before halfway, shaken up 2f out, carried head awkwardly, kept on.

fared better than previously this season from his much-reduced mark, doing best of those held up, but his head carriage was far from pretty once again and it remains to be seen if he's able to build on this; awkward leaving stalls, in rear, not settle fully, pushed along 2f out, carried head high from over 1f out, nearest at the finish.
again did far too much too soon; led, raced too freely, headed over 1f out, weakened.

settled better returned to his usual hold-up tactics and ran respectably on form without troubling the leaders, an element of going through the motions to his season so far; raced off the pace, steady headway from 3f out, not quicken final 1f, never landed a blow.
back up in trip, again didn't get an entirely clear run but didn't pick up at all once in the clear; held up, not clear run 2f out, never a threat.
back down in trip after 9 months off, is best not judged on this run, meeting trouble when trying to get involved; in rear, effort when denied a run over 1f out, never on terms.
found this too competitive and looked a hard ride; hampered start, raced off the pace, took strong hold, driven 3f out, brief headway under 2f out, carried head high, no further impression.

without the headgear this time, ran well with the 1f longer trip in his favour, just not getting anything like as favourable a run up the inside as the winner, unlucky not to finish closer; dwelt, held up, travelled well, no room home turn, headway when forced to switch final 1f, ran on; may do better still.
upped in trip, failed to repeat last effort for form or promise; mid-division, not settle fully, effort 2f out, weakened final 1f.

was much improved from debut, away from the mud, even though still in need of experience, doing good work late on; in rear, carried head bit awkwardly, pushed along 2f out, headway final 1f, kept on, nearest at the finish; likely to progress further.

(€130,000Y: by Blue Point: first foal: dam, 6f winner, half-sister to smart 7f-9f winner Kalsa out of useful 12.5f winner Sovana) was very green; raced wide, in touch, not settle fully, ridden halfway, weakened over 1f out.

racingTvHorseData.name: Desdemona
racingTvHorseData.analystComment: Got back on track this year, winning over C&D in February and following up at Chelmsford (5f) in March. Below form upped in grade when sixth of 12 in handicap back at this course (6f) last month though, and may again prove vulnerable off this mark.

performances.commentFull: proved very easy to back for one searching for a hat-trick and couldn't cope with the step up in class on just her second start beyond the minimum trip; dived left leaving stalls, in touch, raced freely, brief headway over 1f out, no extra final 100 yds.

is going through a purple patch and followed up with his useful claimer offsetting a 5 lb rise in the weights, also benefiting from being ridden with more restraint than usual given the pace burn up; held up, headway under pressure over 1f out, hung left, led final 1f, kept on.

has been running well in defeat of late and went one better than on last 2 starts in decisive fashion, settling better back down at 5f; chased leaders, led final 100 yds, well on top finish; will remain competitive.
encouragingly backed up previous effort to prove herself at 6f and she won't always bump into one as thriving as Beauzon is right now; prominent, raced freely, ridden 2f out, kept on.

ran her best race since her 2-y-o days, positively ridden and outlasting the other pace-forcer; disputed lead, edged ahead final 1f, caught dying strides; she's fallen a long way in the weights and should be up to going one better if keeping this up.
continues to fall in the weights without showing any sign of taking advantage; in touch, dropped away early in straight.
hasn't shown much for current yard but wasn't seen to best effect on this occasion; raced wide, prominent, ridden over 1f out, weakened.
isn't one to be interested in: raced off the pace, ridden when switched 1f out, never involved.
after 4 months off, continues to disappoint this year; held up, ridden early in straight, made no impression.
hasn't fired for her current yard; close up early, settled mid-field after 1f, weakened before final 1f.

in first-time tongue strap, confirmed promise of last run, seen to advantage on the rail but rather impressive and leaving the impression she could've won by even further; broke fast, made running, went with zest, drew clear approaching final 1f, had plenty in hand; she can progress again and will be hard to catch in a 5f nursery.

failed to progress from debut in form terms, though shaped much better than the bare result, showing excellent speed before understandably wilting late on; soon led, went with enthusiasm, went clear before halfway, shaken up over 1f out, edged right, headed final 1f, no extra, did too much too soon; remains open to improvement and capable of winning an ordinary novice.

(by Showcasing: second foal: sister to 2-y-o 6f winner Amroon: dam, winner up to 7f (2-y-o 5f winner), half-sister to useful 2-y-o 6f-1m winner Rainbow Royal out of useful winner up to 6f (including at 2 yrs) Show Rainbow) showed ability in faring best of the rest; soon led, headed over 1f out, left behind by winner final 1f; entitled to progress.

racingTvHorseData.name: Honour Your Dreams
racingTvHorseData.analystComment: Well backed when 2½ lengths second of 9 to Desdemona in handicap (7/2) over C&D on latest outing in February. Is very well treated at present but his profile isn't one of consistency.

performances.commentFull: well backed, wasted no time getting back to form; slowly into stride, mid-field, headway over 1f out, led briefly final 1f, left behind by winner late on; he's dropped to a good mark and looks capable of going one better before long.
back in headgear, wasn't in the same form as last time; mid-field, ridden over 2f out, weakened 1f out.

broke on terms this time and took a step back in the right direction with tongue tie back on, able to adopt more positive tactics on this occasion; disputed lead, raced in narrow second over 1f out, no extra final 1f; his task now is build on this having been given a chance by the handicapper.
with hood quickly discarded, fared little better than last time; slowly into stride, in touch, ridden over 1f out, weakened final 1f.

had been struggling for form when last seen 4 months earlier and, with the tongue strap left off, finished well held; raced wide, pressed leader, pushed along over 2f out, dropped away from over 1f out.
back in a tongue strap, got very warm beforehand and again ran below form, seeming to have gone off the boil for now; close up, not settle fully, led 2f out, headed soon after, weakened.
without a tongue strap this time, fared no better than last time; led until over 1f out, weakening when hampered final 1f.
has picked up 3 wins during this turf season but has struggled with consistency in the main and ran poorly on first outing since leaving Michael Appleby; raced off the pace, struggling from halfway.

is having had a good season and wasted no time getting back to form following his lesser Chepstow effort, turning the tables on All Ways Glamorous with 7-lb claimer in the saddle, albeit hampering that one here and the finish would have been closer but for that; chased leaders, led final 1f, hung right final 100 yds, kept on.
was below form; in touch, ridden halfway, hung left over 1f out, never landed a blow.
wasted no time getting back on track, beaten by a pair who had dropped in the weights; dwelt and bumped start, in touch, effort over 1f out, kept on final 1f.
hampered start, in touch, weakened over 1f out.

turned out again quickly and under a penalty, followed up from Windsor back up in trip; disputed lead, went on 2f out, in command entering final 1f, closed down final 50 yds, always holding on as lead continued to be eroded; this was a weak event and he's likely to prove vulnerable when bidding for the hat-trick.
gained reward for a series of consistent efforts by getting off the mark for the season, this the highest mark from which he's scored; close up, went with zest, ridden 2f out, led final 1f, kept on.
again ran well, this the seventh time he's made the placings since his latest success; close up, led before final 1f, headed last ½f, kept on.
back down in trip, ran well on the back of a breathing operation after 3 months off, making the places for the third successive time; in touch, took strong hold, challenged over 1f out, kept on.

shaped as if still in good form but was still plenty keen enough in a hood instead of cheekpieces and couldn't quite see things out; chased leaders, took strong hold, effort home turn, upsides entering final 1f, no extra only late on; he'll benefit from a return to 5f/6f and look up to winning off this sort of mark.
was too free back in headgear and not in the same form as last time; led, took strong hold, joined over 1f out, headed final 1f, no extra final 100 yds.
back down in trip, followed a good run with a below-par one; close up, pushed along 2f out, weakened final 1f.

turned out again quickly, bounced back to best despite essentially racing with the choke out from the off, doing well to sustain his effort as well as he did in the end; close up, refused to settle, edged ahead 1f out, headed final 1f, kept on.
had made a good start in 2 outings for current yard but was below form this time; prominent, ridden over 1f out, weakened final 1f.

already looks an improved performer just 2 starts in to his career with current yard and went with plenty of zest under a penalty, just proving vulnerable late on back up to 6f; soon led, raced freely, hung right, kicked on over 1f out, ridden final 1f, headed late on.

who attracted late support, got back to winning ways on first outing since leaving Adrian Keatley for 11,000 gns after 10 weeks off, this his first success in over year having dipped 3 lb below last winning mark; made all, raced freely, ridden over 1f out, kept on; has joined a yard that generally does well with new acquisitions and should remain competitive.
without a tongue strap this time, was well backed but ran just respectably; led early, remained prominent, ridden over 1f out, carried head bit awkwardly, one paced.
hasn't had many goes in this grade but proved a let-down; prominent, driven early in straight, weakened over 1f out, carried head bit awkwardly.
wasn't disgraced, doing best of those from off the pace; not ideally drawn, in rear, took keen hold, ridden over 1f out, never on terms.
attracted support but unseated his rider at the start.
a C&D winner last season, benefited from the recent outing as he ran up to best down in grade; went right start, disputed lead, shaken up under 2f out, rallied final 1f, just failed.
was too free without cover back on turf after 4 months off; raced wide, in touch, raced freely, weakened 1f out.

ran well with tongue strap back on, also back in the right sort of grade, travelling with menace; close up, travelled well, challenged 2f out, ridden final 1f, one paced; will continue to give a good account.
back in headgear/upped in grade, ran respectably back at 5f; mid-field, headway halfway, ridden over 1f out, kept on.
wasn't in the same form as last time, not seeing his race out having raced freely early on; mid-field, raced freely, headway under pressure over 1f out, weakened last ½f.
returned to form back sprinting; dwelt, mid-field, raced freely, headway over 1f out, ridden final 1f, kept on.
back up in trip, wasn't seen to best effect and is best forgiven the run; mid-field, out wide when pushed along over 2f out, weakened inside final 1f.

without the headgear this time, moved through the race like a dream but was caught on the hop by one that had already built up a head of steam by the time they reached the furlong pole; mid-field, travelled best, headway from halfway, ridden entering final 1f, kept on; one to be interested in.
wasn't disgraced on the figures but looked less than straightforward; dwelt, in rear, pulled hard, brief headway over 1f out, hung right, no further impression.
was plenty keen enough in first-time blinkers and shaped as if back in form; dwelt, mid-division, took strong hold, not clear run from halfway, got gap last ½f, ran on.
struggled back up in grade; hampered start, mid-field, pushed along 2f out, weakened 1f out.

back under a fully-fledged rider, fared better than of late dropped in grade, looking the likeliest winner entering the final 1f before narrowly giving best to a well-treated sort; dwelt, held up, smooth headway over 1f out, challenged between horses last ½f, just failed.
again ran below form; held up, outpaced 2f out, plugged on.
under a penalty, can have this run overlooked, never involved having been very awkward leaving the stalls (restless beforehand).

justified support after just 4 days off, impressing with how he went through this back down further in trip, value for extra, too; held up, headway on bridle under 2f out, shaken up entering final 1f, led final 50 yds, won cosily; can't go up much for this and he'll remain on a fair mark.

ran well in first-time visor, travelling the best down in grade but unable to put this to bed, his strike rate not great; mid-field, travelled well, headway to lead 1f out, hung left, headed well inside final 1f.
shaped as if still in good form, not getting as clear a run through as some of the other closers; slowly into stride, held up, good headway over 2f out, forced to switch over 1f out, late headway.

without the headgear this time and back up in trip, had been given a much longer break between races this time and ran creditably, a stronger gallop likely to have seen him in an even better light; dwelt, in rear, took strong hold, headway under pressure over 1f out, carried left close home, nearest at the finish.
was below form in first-time cheekpieces after just 3 days off; prominent, led 2f out, hung right, headed final 1f, weakened.
who didn't see things out over further at Beverley last time, returned to form back sprinting; dwelt, raced wide, in touch, outpaced over 2f out, headway over 1f out, plugged on.
back on turf, went backwards from reappearance, unconvincing over the longer trip; held up, not settle fully, pushed along 2f out, carried head awkwardly, weakened final 100 yds.
without a tongue strap this time, ran well after 7 months off, just tiring a little late on; mid-field, effort when short of room over 1f out, carried left and headway soon after, no extra final 1f.
looks more or less exposed by now; held up, raced freely, headway 2f out, no further impression, made little impression.
wasn't up to the task; steadied at the start, in rear, shaken up over 2f out, made no impression.

making handicap debut after just 5 days off, is best not judged on this run, the distance he was beaten exaggerated by suffering interference; close up, ridden over 2f out, hampered over 1f out, weakened final 1f, not persevered with once.
was too free, an attempt to hold onto him backfiring; in touch, pulled hard, ridden 2f out, weakened final 1f.

without a tongue strap this time, just about set the standard and made it fifth time lucky down a little in grade, seeing it out well up in trip; prominent, led over 1f out, asserted final 100 yds, raced freely, stayed on.
wasn't disgraced in first-time tongue strap, just already a bit more exposed than those that beat him; raced wide, in touch, effort 2f out, no extra last ½f.

looked the pick on form and was well backed, but he failed to match his effort from last time, a bit too keen for his own good early on; tracked pace, not settle fully, shaken up 2f out, not quicken, no extra final 1f; he was the pick of these in the paddock and likely best judged on his form last time when he turns up again.
did better with debut under belt, reversing Thirsk form with the third; in touch, headway to lead over 1f out, headed final 100 yds, kept on; he's up to winning a similar race.

(€24,000F, 20,000Y: by Dream Ahead: second foal: half-brother to 2-y-o 6f winner Oil On Canvas (by Anodin): dam, 5.5f winner who stayed 7.5f, sister to useful winner up to 1m Magritte) coltish beforehand, attracted support and produced a promising first effort, knowing more as the race wore on and shaping as though an extra 1f will pose no problems; dwelt, held up, ridden halfway, hung left under 2f out, kept on final 1f; will improve.

racingTvHorseData.name: Wedgewood
racingTvHorseData.analystComment: Came out on top with a fully-fledged rider back in the saddle in 9-runner C&D handicap in March. Yard is going well at present and she remains well handicapped even after a 2 Ib rise for that success.

prompts.start: Wedgewood has finished 1st for 0-20 mph in 3 of their last 4 starts.

performances.commentFull: was 3 lb below last winning mark and came out on top after 8 weeks off with Morris taking back over from 5-lb claimer; broke well, prominent, edged ahead last ½f, kept on.
claimer ridden, underperformed, doing the worse of the 2 pace-forcers; disputed lead, weakened last ½f.

was back at the scene of her last win (also from this mark) and showed a lot more spark at a time when her stable is in flying form, but simply went off to hard; led, drew clear before home turn, headed last ½f, weakened late on.
shaped as if needing the run after 6 months off; tracked pace, ridden out wide home turn, weakened 1f out.
is better on the all-weather and wasn't in the same form as last time; broke well, made running, pushed along under 2f out, headed over 1f out, bumped soon after, weakened final 100 yds.
was well backed and resumed winning ways in dominant fashion, responding well to an attacking ride; made all, kicked on home turn, kept on.
followed a good run with a poor one; prominent, ridden 2f out, weakened 1f out.

was right back to her best and looked to have sealed things only to find herself a touch outbattled by the winner, not helped by that one leaning into her, but she did have every chance and can't really be classed as an unlucky loser; handy, challenged over 1f out, led last ½f, carried left and headed close home.
set a true pace before weakening, possibly still neding this; led until final 1f, weakened.
shaped as if needing the run after 5 months off; led, took keen hold, headed final 1f, weakened.
again ran well, giving best only very late on having wandered off a true line in the closing stages; broke well, led, ridden 2f out, wandered/hung right final 1f, edged out close home.
broke well to grab the rail and ran well having been in the firing line throughout; led, ridden over 1f out, headed well inside final 1f.
wasn't in the same form as last time; led, headed over 1f out, no extra final 1f.
capitalised on the drop in grade; close up, led 2f out, went on 1f out, always holding on.
again fell short of her recent Lingfield form kept to turf; in rear, headway around halfway, ridden 2f out, not sustain effort.

under a penalty for last week's Lingfield win, couldn't back that up returned to turf, her reponse to pressure when challenging the winner a disappointing one; prominent, upsides over 1f out, folded last ½f.
built on promise of last run to break a losing streak of almost a year; broke well, took keen hold, chased leader after 1f, led again home turn, quickened clear under 2f out, eased final 50 yds.

well backed, ran well after just 2 days off and deserves extra credit having got no peace up front, an early duel with Suanni leaving her vulnerable to the winner late on; disputed lead, went on over 2f out, headed final 100 yds, no extra.
ran well and had every chance before being turned away by the winner in the final 1f; broke well, disputed lead, challenged over 1f out, no extra late on.
confirmed her return to form; led early, remained prominent after 1f, disputed lead again 2f out, kept on until last ½f.
returned to form from out of the blue; chased leader, led over 1f out, edged right, headed inside last ½f, no extra; remains to be seen if able to back this up.
raced wide, prominent, weakened over 1f out.
after 9 weeks off, again finished well held; close up, weakened over 1f out.
possibly needed the run after 6 months off, though setting a strong gallop at 6f is never likely to prove fruitful for her; led, ran wide entering straight, headed over 1f out, weakened.
took a step back in the right direction, showing good speed back down in trip; led, travelled well, tackled over 1f out, headed inside final 1f, no extra only late on.
didn't see out the extra furlong, though is still yet to show anything like her all-weather form on turf in any case; led until over 1f out, no extra final 1f.
under a 6-lb penalty, was below form attempting the 4-timer after just 5 days off, a busy time of late perhaps just telling on her; prominent, hung right over 1f out, weakened final 1f.
completed the hat-trick in smooth fashion, proving much too good for some very limited rivals; soon led, travelled well, quickened over 2f out, soon clear; will remain of interest.

easy to back, followed up from last time and is improving in leaps and bounds, now 2-2 over C&D and displaying a good turn of foot once again; prominent, travelled well, quickened to lead early in straight, won readily; looks up to completing the hat-trick.

showed much improved form to get off the mark in a lowly contest after 5 months off, Doyle not needing to resort to the whip once she quickened up in the clear; handy, short of room entering straight, switched over 1f out, quickened to lead final 50 yds, had bit in hand.
easy to back, backed up previous effort; chased leaders, took strong hold, every chance 1f out, kept on.
whose stable is going well, ran well switched to all-weather; mid-field, headway over 1f out, kept on.
failed to repeat her last effort off the same mark; chased leader, driven under 2f out, no extra.
showed first form down in a lesser contest; prominent, led over 2f out, headed final 100 yds, no extra.
making nursery debut after 6 weeks off (2 lb out of weights), continues to show little; waited with, came wide early in straight, ridden when hung right under 2f out, never dangerous.
fared no better; led until 2f out, weakened.
did no better for debut, but did show speed that may serve her well in low-grade nurseries later on; led until over 1f out, weakened.
(by Outstrip: first foal: dam 5f winner) not bred to be much, looks one for the longer term; always behind.

racingTvHorseData.name: She Went Whoosh
racingTvHorseData.analystComment: Sole success came over C&D for Richard Hannon. Has been struggling outside of classified company of late and is hard to make a case for here.

performances.commentFull: might have made the frame but fared no better than of late in ratings terms; mid-field, ridden 1f out, not quicken.
continues below form; chased leader, pushed along 3f out, weakened final 1f.
ran to a similar level to last time; led, headed approaching final 1f, weakened.

had got to within ¾ length of the winner over C&D last time but was blown away by him on this occasion, paying late on for keeping early tabs on him; chased leaders, ridden under 3f out, left behind by winner early in straight, weakened final 100 yds.
turned out again quickly, returned to form from out of the blue; prominent, ridden over 2f out, kept on; her task now is to back this up.
didn't land much of a blow back in handicap company; in rear, headway under pressure over 1f out, switched, one paced.
is yet to fire for current yard; always behind.
continues to show little; raced off the pace, never involved.
offered little on first outing since leaving Richard Hannon (sold only 1,000 gns), reported to have lost her action; in touch, weakened final 1f.
again ran below form with cheekpieces quickly discarded; mid-field, shaken up home turn, no extra final 1f.
in first-time cheekpieces, wasn't in the same form as last time; prominent, pushed along before halfway, weakened over 1f out, eased off.
is now 4 lb below last winning mark and ran better than for a while; prominent, challenged 2f out, no extra last ½f; her task now is to prove she can build on this.
one of several done no favours leaving the stalls, shaped as if better for the run after 3 months off; hampered soon after start, settled in touch, weakened over 1f out.
is operating below best at present; in touch, ridden when short of room over 1f out, weakened final 1f.
ran poorly back on all-weather, never able to get involved from off the pace; soon behind, brief headway over 1f out, never on terms.

a winner here on all-weather, had been given a longer break between races and is better than she could show on this occasion, racing towards the outer flank and away from the principals; in touch, effort 2f out, no extra final 1f.
under a penalty, followed a good run with a below-par one back on turf; mid-field, ridden when hampered briefly 1f out, weakened.

has had plenty of tries in similar company but has proven reasonably consistent and finally got off the mark in something of a blanket finish; in touch, headway over 1f out, led final 100 yds, kept on; she won't go up much and should remain competitive.
ran creditably, just doing a bit too much and having nothing left late on; close up, shaken up over 2f out, led soon after, ridden final 1f, headed soon after, weakened final 50 yds.
wasn't disgraced in a better race than last time; prominent, every chance over 1f out, weakened last ½f.
stepped up on recent run back at 5f; prominent, ridden over 1f out, hung left final 1f, no extra late on, no match for winner.
back up in trip, showed bright speed but ultimately shaped as if needing the run after 3 months off; soon led, headed 2f out, weakened final 1f.
back down in trip, ran creditably after 10 weeks off but was a sitting duck for the winner having always been in the firing line; close up, went on 2f out, headed last ½f, no extra.
easy to back, wasn't in the same form as last time back up in trip, the more testing ground a plausible excuse; in touch, ridden 2f out, weakened final 1f.

took step forward switched to handicaps and is likley to be suited even further by a step up in trip; dived right leaving stalls, in rear, ridden from 2f out, switched approaching final 1f, carried head bit awkwardly/ran green initially, kept on.
back down in trip, fared little better than last time under more testing conditions, beaten by more than a wide trip; raced off the pace, ridden home turn, never involved.
went backwards from debut, possibly finding the race coming too soon; prominent, ridden over 2f out, weakened final 1f.

(82,000 2-y-o: by Profitable: second foal: dam lightly-raced half-sister to smart 1¼m-1½m winner Tanfeeth out of useful winner up to 1m (2-y-o 6f winner) (stayed easy 1¼m) Nasij) produced a promising first effort and should benefit from further in time; dwelt, mid-division, shaken up 2f out, ran on, not knocked about; will improve.

racingTvRaceData.analystVerdict: TUSCAN POINT has made a positive start for Adam Kirby on the whole and gets the nod from Wedgewood, who looks the most obvious danger in this small-field race.
racingTvRaceData.ipHintsSpecificPace: This could develop into a sprint for home, and Wedgewood could be well placed to capitalise.
racingTvRaceData.ipHintsIndividualPace: She Went Whoosh has traded at 50% or less of Betfair SP twice on its last 5 starts: Honour Your Dreams has traded at 50% or less of Betfair SP twice on its last 5 starts.
